patches.name: Abstract shim layer
patches.description: Adds an abstracted shim layer for fields, which improves compatibility to allow legacy patches to work.

options.description: JSON containing static field initialization strings. If this is not provided, the patch may fail.
Strings that must be used as local variables rather than global variables to restore the original method structure

patches.name: Abstract shim layer for method
patches.description: Adds an abstracted shim layer for methods, which improves compatibility to allow legacy patches to work.

options.description:
If true, a shim layer for the synthetic method is added.

Enable if testing is required.

patches.name: Abstract shim layer for native library
patches.description: Adds an abstracted shim layer for native libraries, which improves compatibility to allow legacy patches to work.

repoDescription: This project shims legacy APIs by adding a lightweight compatibility layer, such as restoring or remapping deprecated code
